coveredCases: Approval-pending rows contribute zero; approved public members increment once and exact command receipt retries do not duplicate the count.
Mute/clear changes count independently from admission; repeated clear preserves the count. Muting survives departure/rejoin until explicitly cleared.
Departure and separate admission into another Realm preserve both count projections; no direct scope move is allowed.
The membership identity survives a new generation; direct identity deletion and foreign-scope mutation are rejected.
Missing and underflowed counters reject an actual native leave. The fixture rolls corruption back without weakening the guard.
Private-principal enrollment and departure never alter public Entity membership counts.
Hard deletion of a referenced Realm is rejected; soft deletion retains enrollment/history until explicit departure.
Original latest-governance pointer cases retain timestamp/UUID ordering, foreign Realm/wrong action rejection and immutable action/case evidence.
Deferred consent/history constraints run after each complete enrollment command before later generations in the rollback transaction.
limits: No HTTP, role/representation issuance policy, concurrent throughput, 500M/3B load or complete governance/report gate is claimed.

The final projection run uses the rebuilt empty installed coverage target. Other tail checks use the populated seed target; these distinct environments are not a single fresh whole-system acceptance run.
Coverage seed still requires native catalog report revision evidence and all retained consumers; this fixture does not remove that requirement.
Latest-governance SQL cases qualify projection/immutability constraints, not the product decision-command authorization or report-evidence API.
